stroke.label: Stroke / suspected stroke (guideline pathway)
stroke.advice: Suspected stroke is time-critical. Call 112 (or 108 for an ambulance) NOW.

dialysis.label: Dialysis / kidney failure (guideline pathway)
dialysis.advice: If dialysis has been missed for days or symptoms are severe, call 112 (or 108).

burns.label: Burns (guideline pathway)
burns.advice: Serious burns are time-critical. Call 112 (or 108 for an ambulance) NOW.

snakebite.label: Snakebite (guideline pathway)
snakebite.advice: Snakebite is time-critical. Call 112 (or 108 for an ambulance) NOW.

poisoning.label: Poisoning / overdose (guideline pathway)
poisoning.advice: Poisoning is time-critical. Call 112 (or 108 for an ambulance) NOW.

mental_health.label: Mental-health crisis (guideline pathway)
mental_health.advice: If there is risk of self-harm, call 112 (or 108) or Tele-MANAS 14416 now.

fallback.label: Unrecognised problem (general-care fallback)
fallback.advice: We could not map this description to a known complaint. If it feels urgent, call 112 (or 108).
